description: Table figure: guanine-reading module across TAX-4, CNGA1, CNGB1 and mapped TAX-2
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9})

rows=[
 ("TAX-4 (C. elegans)","5H3O chain A, cGMP","T576 (2.6 A)","K619 (3.0 A)","D620 (6.0 A)","yes, measured"),
 ("CNGA1 (human)","7RHH chain A, cGMP","T562 (2.7 A)","K605 (4.1 A)","D606 (>6 A)","yes, measured"),
 ("CNGB1 (human)","7RHH chain B, cGMP","T1043 (2.7 A)","none (Ser1086)","none (Asn1087)","yes, measured"),
 ("TAX-2 (C. elegans)","no structure; mapped","T619","Asn662","D663","inferred"),
]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["subunit","source","guanine Thr","C-helix Lys","C-helix Asp","evidence"])
df.to_csv("out/guanine_module.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.6))
ax.axis("off")
tbl=ax.table(cellText=df.values, colLabels=df.columns, loc="center", cellLoc="center")
tbl.auto_set_font_size(False); tbl.set_fontsize(9); tbl.scale(1,1.9)
for (r,c),cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#2d5f8b"); cell.set_text_props(color="white",weight="bold")
    elif df.iloc[r-1,0].startswith("TAX-2"): cell.set_facecolor("#fff3d6")
    elif df.iloc[r-1,0].startswith("CNGB1"): cell.set_facecolor("#f3e8f3")
ax.set_title("Guanine-reading module: residues within 6 A of the guanine ring of bound cGMP\n"
             "distances computed from deposited coordinates; TAX-2 positions mapped by structure-anchored alignment",
             fontsize=10,pad=14)
plt.show()
